name: Cesty Milklitt
original_name: セスティ＝ミルクリット
source:
[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20010306012912/http://lin2.magical.gr.jp/~akira/alchimie/nohtml/cesty.html]Official Website[/url]]
Although they are different in age, they have known each other since childhood, and although they are supposed to be in different grades, through her efforts, she had skipped a grade and is now in the same grade with the protagonist. She knows the protagonist's true side well. She used to wear glasses all the time.
